_comment: Default bindings for Another World: the keyboard as rawgl has it - the arrows, Space and Enter for fire, C for Code, P for Pause, and the letters
and Backspace for the password screen (C and P are also the letters C and P, as in rawgl, where typing P on the password screen also pauses).
The first pad: the d-pad and left stick as the arrows, A as fire, Start as Pause, Back as Code.

Another World.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Another World.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Another World.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Another World.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
Another World.P1 Action: Space, Enter, J1 B1, X1 A
